name: CareClinic
tagline: Clinic practice management & telemedicine: patient portal, doctor workstation, front desk ops, SOAP records, and WebRTC visits.
description:
A comprehensive healthcare and telemedicine platform built for multi-specialty polyclinics, private practices, and telehealth networks. Designed as three specialized web applications connected to a single high-performance TypeScript backend and PostgreSQL database.

Patients search multi-specialty doctors, inspect credentials and consultation fees, book in-clinic or telemedicine video visits with double-booking prevention, pay consultation fees online, join secure video consultation rooms with real-time waiting room queues, review signed immutable e-prescriptions, download diagnostic lab reports, and manage family medical profiles. Doctors operate a tablet-first clinical workstation with today's token queue, availability schedule configuration, full patient medical history access with mandatory security audit logging, SOAP clinical notes (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan), ICD-10 diagnostic coding, and structured e-prescription builder with drug dosage guidelines. Front desk staff and clinic administrators manage patient check-in with physical token generation, doctor room allocations, walk-in scheduling, billing invoices, cancellation refunds, and clinic performance analytics.

Runs 100% offline with zero external cloud dependencies: WebRTC video sessions, payments, and SMS alerts operate via realistic platform mock adapters, populated with a deterministic seed of 12 multi-specialty doctors, 150 patients, 900 appointments, and comprehensive clinical consultations.

features: Dynamic doctor availability slot generation with database-level double-booking prevention
Multi-stage appointment lifecycle machine (booked -> checked_in -> in_consult -> completed)
Tablet-optimized physician clinical workstation with SOAP documentation and ICD-10 coding
Structured e-prescription generator with dosage guidelines and immutable digital signature
In-browser WebRTC telemedicine video consultation room with live chat and queue indicator
Mandatory chart access audit trail logging every medical record, SOAP, and lab report inspection
Diagnostic lab ordering and report repository with automated physiological reference range flags
Front desk patient check-in console with automated daily queue token assignment
Comprehensive clinic billing invoices with automated cancellation refund calculation
Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for queue advancement and telehealth call alerts
